tools.name: describe
tools.description:
What Ultrapedia holds: the queryable views, every column and what it means,
the allowed values of category columns, and how many races there are. Read this
before writing SQL for `query`.

tools.name: query
tools.description:
Run one read-only SQL SELECT (SQLite) over the views `races`, `editions` and
`sources`. Returns columns and rows; `truncated` is true when more rows exist
than `limit` (max 500). Example:
SELECT slug, name, date, city FROM races WHERE state='CO'
AND distance_category='100M' AND date >= date('now') O

tools.name: search_races
tools.description:
Find races. `text` matches the name, city or start location; `state` is a
two-letter code; `distance_category` is one of the values in `describe`; dates
are yyyy-mm-dd and filter the current edition's date. Returns the main columns;
use `get_race` for everything about one race.

tools.name: get_race
tools.description:
Everything about one race: its values, its editions, and for every value the
page it was read from and the verbatim quote.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description:
Read a public web page the way this server reads it when it checks a quote:
its visible text and its links. Use it before `propose_correction` to copy an
exact quote, or to read a race page your own tools cannot open. `find` returns
only the passages around that text. A value that is a URL (website_

tools.name: propose_correction
tools.description:
Send a value for one field of one race, read from a web page — a correction
or a value the index is missing. `field` is a column name from `describe`;
`value` is in that column's form and units (gain_m in metres, dates yyyy-mm-dd,
start_time HH:MM 24h, price_usd a number). `quote` must be copied ver

tools.name: propose_race
tools.description:
Send a US ultramarathon the index does not have yet. Check with search_races
first. `quote` is copied verbatim from `source_url` and names the race. One call
for each distance (a 50K and a 100M at the same event are two races).

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description:
Report something a single value cannot fix: a cancelled or discontinued race,
two rows for the same race, a race filed under the wrong distance. Include a
source and quote when you have one.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "query" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_source, propose_correction · Public sink: propose_correction, propose_race · Destructive: query, propose_correction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_source, propose_correction · Public sink: propose_correction, propose_race · Destructive: query, propose_correction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
